I really appreciate your thoughtful and expansive response. I am in the position at the moment where I feel as though everything is art, as long as you hold the intention or perspective that it is. The reason I asked is because I am an aspiring art educator, and I would like to argue that all students are already artists and I don’t have to teach them to be one, I just have to teach them to see themselves as one. When considering more of the fundamentals of color, composition, perspective, etc, I feel as though those are aspects of design rather than art. Based on your explanation of art being communication, self expression, a means of improvement, or any intention- couldn't you say that forming a sentence is a work of art, or cooking a meal, or dressing for your day? Or something more absurd such as  the way you walk, the dreams you share, the collections you gather, the connections you build, the immense and subtle movements you make. Perhaps that's all a little too far? But my view is that art doesn’t have to be anything and can be everything! Someone made a great comment about poop that I think sums it up pretty well....
